name: Felix feUSD
oneLiner: feUSD is Felix Protocol's Liquity-v2-fork dollar on Hyperliquid, minted from overcollateralized CDPs against HYPE, kHYPE, wstHYPE, and bridged BTC.
collateral: HYPE, kHYPE, wstHYPE, and UBTC (feUBTC) via overcollateralized CDPs on Hyperliquid (Liquity V2 fork); the live adapter reports four active branches
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized CDP (Liquity V2 fork) with direct redemption for $1 of collateral; interest-rate-sorted redemption queue (lower-rate positions redeemed first); stability pools absorb liquidations

oracleRisk.summary: Felix feUSD uses RedStone price-feed contracts for its CDP collateral branches, but reviewed docs do not document fallback, delay, or shutdown behavior.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: FEUSD has HyperEVM/Hyperliquid deployments and candidate evidence points to Hyperliquid canonical routing. With no separate issuer bridge protocol resolved, the route is reviewed as canonical ecosystem bridge exposure.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: reviewed metadata or audit notes identify direct seizure, freeze, blacklist, privileged burn, proxy-upgrade, or chain-governance intervention authority despite decentralized governance labeling.

mintAuthority.summary: feUSD is minted from Liquity-v2-fork CDPs on Hyperliquid (HyperEVM) against HYPE, kHYPE, wstHYPE, and bridged BTC at user-set interest rates. The feUSD token (0x02c6a2fa) is an EIP-1967 proxy whose ProxyAdmin (0x44a600c0) is owned by a central admin contract (0xf42fdd95, itself a UUPS proxy). That admin proxy's own ProxyAdmin (0xdf1293b4) is owned by a Gnosis Safe 1.3.0 multisig (0x699090e7, 3-of-6, no modules, no guard). The same multisig is the ultimate upgrade authority for the entire Felix protocol.

controls.label: Felix CDP branch contracts (collateral mint)
controls.capDescription: Per-asset and global feUSD mint caps plus block-level mint/redemption caps; bounded by per-trove collateral ratio with $1-of-collateral redemption.
controls.evidence: At HyperEVM block 37553335: feUSD token (0x02c6a2fa58cc01a18b8d9e00ea48d65e4df26c70) is an EIP-1967 proxy (implementation slot = 0x444322c3c54908fa5a7842a4f3ff085ec67f2598, proxy admin slot = 0x44a600c031dbdf652500f4a6d84b168056f13692). ProxyAdmin confirmed by getProxyImplementation returning the implementation address.

controls.label: Felix admin multisig (ultimate upgrade and parameter authority)
controls.evidence: Admin chain traced at HyperEVM block 37553335: feUSD ProxyAdmin (0x44a600c0) owner() = 0xf42fdd95 (UUPS proxy → impl 0xd2fe30); 0xf42f owns the Felix AddressesRegistry (0x9de1e57049) per owner() call. The ProxyAdmin of 0xf42f (0xdf1293b4) owner() = 0x699090e73c4077ef2af42773b31788c6564f079c. That Safe: getOwners() = 6 addresses, slot3=6 (ownerCount), slot4=3 (threshold), masterCopy at slot0=0xfb1bffc9d739b8d520daf37df666da4c687191ea (VERSION=1.3.0), getModules()=empty, guard slot=0x0.

review.evidence: On-chain reads at HyperEVM block 37553335 traced the full Felix admin chain: feUSD token (0x02c6a2fa) → ProxyAdmin (0x44a600c0, owner=0xf42fdd95) → 0xf42fdd95 is a UUPS proxy (impl=0xd2fe30, proxyAdmin=0xdf1293b4) → 0xdf1293b4 owner()=0x699090e7 → Gnosis Safe 1.3.0 (3-of-6, 6 EOA signers, no modules, no guard, fallback handler=0x017062a1). The same 0xf42f proxy is confirmed as owner of the Felix AddressesRegistry (0x9de1e57049c475736289cb006212f3e1dce4711b). The 3-of-6 Safe is the ultimate admin authority.
